verdict.rationale: Sentry's homepage claims Seer, a built-in debugging agent, finds root causes of production issues and generates merge-ready patches. That is AI-generated insight and suggestions drawn from the user's error data inside the product. However, it is backed only by two short marketing lines, with no in-depth docs or hands-on corroboration. The Agents Insights dashboards monitor the user's own AI apps and do not themselves produce AI-generated insights, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: first-party docs on how Seer analyzes data and surfaces insights, details on suggestion types beyond root cause and patches, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Find root causes and fix production issues with [Seer, our debugging agent](https://sentry.io/product/seer/).
Fixes what’s broken while you ship what’s next – generating precise, merge-ready patches.
